description: Related MTFT research is a starting point for investigation, not evidence of a derived SM vertex.

qcd.requirement: Derive the SU(3) fundamental generators, structure constants, relative three/four-gluon couplings and Ward identities in a normalized 4D theory.

ew_fermion.requirement: Identify physical chiral fermions, hypercharges, charged-current mixing and normalized electroweak currents.

gauge_self.requirement: Derive the broken electroweak gauge action, gauge-field normalization and correlated cubic/quartic couplings.

higgs_yukawa.requirement: Identify physical Higgs and fermion modes, canonically normalize kinetic terms, obtain chirality and Yukawa tensors, then compare mass-basis vertices.

higgs_gauge.requirement: Derive the normalized scalar kinetic term, physical Higgs direction and W/Z couplings; a mode count alone is insufficient.

higgs_self.requirement: Derive the Higgs potential, vacuum and normalization, including the relationship between its cubic and quartic terms.

goldstone.requirement: Specify a consistent gauge fixing and derive Goldstone interactions from the same broken gauge theory as the physical vertices.

ghost.requirement: Construct the Faddeev–Popov/BRST sector from a declared gauge-fixing functional; no ghost-sector derivation is asserted by this atlas.

benchmarks.process: e+ e- > mu+ mu- QED=2 QCD=0
benchmarks.purpose: Photon/Z currents and interference; keep input masses and electroweak scheme explicit.

benchmarks.process: u u~ > g g QCD=2 QED=0
benchmarks.purpose: Quark and three-gluon structures; check the summed amplitude and Ward identities.

benchmarks.process: e+ e- > w+ w- QED=2 QCD=0
benchmarks.purpose: Gauge cancellations need all contributing diagrams and consistent parameters.
A first Higgs Yukawa target once MTFT has a normalized physical vertex.
